jobs.title: Head of Communications (80-100%)
jobs.description:
.adjust-padding{ padding-left:15px !important; }

Skyguide provides air navigation services in Switzerland and parts of neighbouring countries. With around 1500 employees from more than 30 nations, we are pursuing an ambitious innovation strategy that is based on a strong safety and learning culture. We are guided by four values: “We team up to succeed”, “We drive innovation”, “We own what we do” and, finally, “We create great customer value”. Are you interested in finding out more? We want you to join us as a/an ...

Location: Wangen b. Dübendorf When: 1 October 2026

Your mission: In this role, you will shape how we communicate our purpose, strengthen trust, and position our brand in a highly visible and complex environment. As a strategic advisor to senior leadership, you will connect people, business priorities, and stakeholder expectations through clear, impactful storytelling. Your leadership will help foster engagement, support transformation, and protect Skyguide’s reputation as a trusted aviation service provider. Your tasks:
• Define and drive Skyguide’s corporate communications strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and organizational priorities
• Act as a trusted communications advisor to the CEO, Executive Board, and senior leaders on positioning, messaging, and stakeholder engagement
• Lead internal and external communications, creating consistent, transparent, and impactful experiences across all channels
• Strengthen Skyguide’s reputation through proactive media relations, executive communications, and strategic brand management
• Drive employee engagement, leadership communication, and change initiatives that support culture and organizational transformation
• Oversee communication risk management, crisis communication preparedness, and stakeholder communications in a dynamic environment
• Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing communications team while continuously advancing communication processes and digital capabilities
• Provide strategic leadership across corporate communications and closely corporate communications functions, ensuring a coherent narrative, strong institutional positioning, and effective engagement with internal and external stakeholder What we are looking for:
• Master’s degree in Communications, Business, Political Science, or a related field, complemented by relevant professional development
• Extensive experience in corporate communications, media relations, executive communications, and brand management within complex organizations
• Broad understanding of corporate affairs, public policy, institutional stakeholder engagement and reputation management in a complex and regulated environment
• Proven track record as a strategic advisor to executive and board-level stakeholders, with strong influencing and relationship-building skills
• Excellent communication, analytical, and crisis management skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear and compelling messages
• Strong leadership experience with a passion for developing inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing teams
• Demonstrated success in leading transformation, change communication, and employee engagement initiatives
• Proficient in English written and orally, good command in French and/or German is a plus

What we offer: We offer flexible working options, depending on the role, and a competitive salary with attractive working conditions and numerous fringe benefits. Our employees have access to a wide range of training opportunities to support their growth and development. As an equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, bringing together people of different identities and backgrounds.

Siamo guidati da quattro valori: “Siamo in team per avere successo”, “Siamo in grado di guidare l’innovazione”, “Siamo proprietari di quello che facciamo” e, infine, “Creiamo un grande valore del cliente”. Sei interessato a saperne di più? Vogliamo che ti unisca a noi come... Ubicazione: Wangen b. Dübendorf Quando: 1 ottobre 2026 La vostra missione: In questo ruolo, si modella come comunicheremo il nostro scopo, rafforzare la fiducia e posizionare il nostro marchio in un ambiente altamente visibile e complesso. Come consulente strategico per la leadership senior, si collegherà le persone, le priorità di business e le aspettative degli stakeholder attraverso una chiara, efficace storytelling. La vostra leadership aiuterà a promuovere il coinvolgimento, la trasformazione di supporto e proteggere la reputazione di Skyguide come fornitore di servizi di aviazione di fiducia. I vostri compiti:
• Definire e guidare la strategia di comunicazione aziendale di Skyguide, garantendo l’allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le priorità organizzative
• Agire come consulente di comunicazione di fiducia per l'Amministratore Delegato, il Consiglio Direttivo e i leader senior sul posizionamento, la messaggistica e l'impegno degli stakeholder
• Condurre comunicazioni interne ed esterne, creando esperienze coerenti, trasparenti e di impatto in tutti i canali
• Rafforzare la reputazione di Skyguide attraverso relazioni proattive dei media, comunicazioni esecutive e gestione strategica del marchio
• Guidare l'impegno dei dipendenti, la comunicazione di leadership e le iniziative di cambiamento che sostengono la cultura e la trasformazione organizzativa
• Superare la gestione dei rischi di comunicazione, la preparazione della comunicazione di crisi e le comunicazioni degli stakeholder in un ambiente dinamico
• Guidare, ispirare e sviluppare un team di comunicazione altamente performante, aumentando continuamente i processi di comunicazione e le capacità digitali
• Fornire leadership strategica attraverso le comunicazioni aziendali e le funzioni di comunicazione strettamente aziendali, garantendo una narrazione coerente, un forte posizionamento istituzionale e un efficace impegno con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Laurea magistrale in Comunicazione, Business, Scienze Politiche, o un campo correlato, completato da sviluppo professionale rilevante
• Ampia esperienza nella comunicazione aziendale, nelle relazioni multimediali, nelle comunicazioni esecutive e nella gestione del marchio all'interno di organizzazioni complesse
• Ampia comprensione degli affari aziendali, della politica pubblica, dell'impegno degli stakeholder istituzionali e della gestione della reputazione in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato
• Dimostrato il record di traccia come consulente strategico per le parti interessate esecutive e di livello del consiglio, con forti influenze e capacità di costruzione di relazioni
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, analisi e gestione delle crisi, con la capacità di tradurre la complessità in messaggi chiari e convincenti
• Forte esperienza di leadership con la passione per lo sviluppo di team inclusivi, collaborativi e altamente performanti
• Successo dimostrativo nelle principali iniziative di trasformazione, cambiamento di comunicazione e coinvolgimento dei dipendenti
• Proficiente in inglese scritto e per via orale, buon comando in francese e/o tedesco è un plus Che cosa offriamo: Offriamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili, a seconda del ruolo, e uno stipendio competitivo con le condizioni di lavoro attraenti e numerosi vantaggi frangia. I nostri dipendenti hanno accesso a una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione per sostenere la loro crescita e lo sviluppo. Come datore di lavoro di pari opportunità, ci impegniamo a costruire una squadra diversificata e inclusiva, mettendo insieme persone di diversa identità e background.

We are guided by four values: “We team up to succeed”, “We drive innovation”, “We own what we do” and, finally, “We create great customer value”. Are you interested in finding out more? We want you to join us as a/an ...

Location: Wangen b. Dübendorf When: 1 October 2026 or upon availability

Your mission: As a Network Architect, you will drive the evolution of Skyguide’s IT and network infrastructure, shaping a secure, resilient, and future-ready connectivity landscape. You act as a trusted advisor to engineering teams, management, and business stakeholders, guiding the adoption of innovative networking technologies and architectural best practices. As part of the Platform team and the broader architecture community, you define and own reusable infrastructure building blocks, enabling scalable, reliable, and secure network services across all products. You bring vision, technical excellence, and a collaborative mindset to ensure our network architecture meets today’s operational demands while preparing for tomorrow’s challenges. Your tasks:
• Define, design, and own network architecture building blocks, ensuring they are scalable, reusable, and aligned with enterprise strategy
• Drive the evolution of the network landscape, incorporating modern networking paradigms
• Provide architectural guidance and support to engineering teams in adopting advanced networking technologies and solutions
• Advise management and business stakeholders on networking technology trends, risks, and strategic opportunities
• Ensure network security is embedded by design, aligned with relevant frameworks, standards, and best practices
• Collaborate across domains (compute, storage, cloud, and applications) to ensure end-to-end system integration
• Develop and maintain architectural documentation, standards, and models What we are looking for:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
• Proven experience in network architecture within complex, high-reliability or safety-critical environments
• Experience in architecture documentation and modelling practices
• Routing & Switching: advanced knowledge of enterprise vendors like Cisco, Juniper or Extreme Networks
• Communication: You adapt your communication style to the context and stakeholders and actively ask for information through relevant questions and active listening
• Credibility & accountability: You are transparent in your actions, explaining the reasoning behind them, and consistently follow through on your commitments
• Proficient in English written and orally, good command in German or French is a plus

What we offer: We offer flexible working options, depending on the role, and a competitive salary with attractive working conditions and numerous fringe benefits. Our employees have access to a wide range of training opportunities to support their growth and development. As an equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, bringing together people of different identities and backgrounds.
